name: expense-tracker
description: Desktop application for reliable expense management

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:desktop: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm prune --omit=dev --prefix server && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.build:installer: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm prune --omit=dev --prefix server && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
